summary_1line: The Pandavas finalize disguises for their incognito year, and priest Dhaumya instructs them on careful conduct while living unnoticed in a king’s court.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi stands before the Pandavas declaring she will disguise herself as a Sairindhri skilled in dressing hair.
The Pandavas sit in counsel with the priest Dhaumya as he raises his hand and instructs them on how to behave in a king’s palace.
